parameters.content:
## Replanner v2 (lite)
Same input and outputs as the old 1.3. Steps: 0 gather (no AI) → 1 Diagnose → 2 Plan (IDs only) → 3 Rule check (code, up to 2 retries, then old plan kept + email to Rira) → 4 AgenticOrg challenger (agent id in Config; if it errors the run continues) → 5 Write + Build Docs (code copies activity steps) → 6 Docs, sheet, 1.4 Email the teacher.

Models: OpenAI gpt-5.5 (Plan), gpt-5.4-mini (Diagnose, Write).
